extra.reason: Implemented and documented repeatable --remove and --remove-match selectors. Verified with 352 passing tests, type checking, lint, formatting, and package build.
Already fixed by kvuvyoltylwq (blockOpener capture + restore). Regression tests for the reported scenario added and verified to fail against the old logic; full suite green.

Implemented and verified: new src/block-reader.ts (readBlocks extraction, tag-tolerant marker matching, provenance capture), --read global option in config plugin, read branch in CLI (byte-exact stdout, exit 1 on missing/unreadable, header banner suppressed via custom renderHeader), README rows, 17 new tests (unit + CLI round-trip). Full suite 371 passing, tsgo/oxlint/oxfmt clean on touched files. Verified live against compfuzor deployments: zim-main-zimenv/.zshenv and both mise bash blocks diff identical to their sources; injected drift is caught.
Shipped --adopt REGEX with CLI docs, first-line replacement, idempotent ensure and read coverage; pnpm check and pnpm test pass (376 tests).
Fixed documented --create false update-only behavior for missing file/block, tested unchanged creation modes; pnpm check and pnpm test pass (376 tests).
Implemented opaque provenance labels and ensured insert/update/read documentation; pnpm check and pnpm test pass (392 tests).
Implemented exact lowercase none/false source suppression, including removal of prior provenance; pnpm check and pnpm test pass (392 tests).
Implemented keep/never/separators, CLI help and README, unknown-value validation, EOF/in-place/anchored/adopt/backup coverage; pnpm check and pnpm test pass (392 tests).

Implemented and verified: terminal flips in the --remove family (no stdin read, exit 1 when the block is missing, idempotent), one-layer indent-preserving line transform with blank/provenance lines untouched, [commented] opener tag managed structurally outside --tag-mode, emission persistence so updates of a commented block stay commented, --commented modifier, --additive guard. Verified by test/block-commenter.test.ts and test/comment-out-cli.test.ts (37 new tests; full suite 431 passing, typecheck/lint/fmt clean). Design: .design/comment-out/draft.glm-5.3.md; commits mtxzxkqt (design) and lmzomuoy (feature).

Implemented and verified: --read-uncommented implies read mode, strips one comment prefix from each body line that carries it, header suppressed so stdout stays byte-exact; plain --read unchanged verbatim. Verified in test/comment-out-cli.test.ts reads section; full suite 431 passing. Implemented alongside bif-comment-out in commit lmzomuoy.

Implemented and verified: --comment-out-all/--uncomment-all take space-separated names, merge with the base flips within a family, gate every addressed name through duplicate/nested/unmatched conflict checks, skip stdin (terminal op), exit 1 when nothing is addressed. flipBlocks generalized to exact-name lists (closers bound to the open block's name; FlippedBlock records the name). Verified by test/comment-out-cli.test.ts family-flags suite and test/block-commenter.test.ts (19 new tests; full suite 450 passing, typecheck/lint/fmt clean); standalone bundle spot-checked at v1.2.0. Commits 6a3182d0, 0a972fb1, d48ed661.

Implemented and verified: --comment-out-match/--uncomment-match (repeatable regexes) flip blocks whose captured names match, mirroring --remove-match; mixed comment-out/uncomment families error; conflicts per concrete matched name; exit 1 when no name matches. Verified by test/comment-out-cli.test.ts family-flags suite and test/block-commenter.test.ts pattern tests; full suite 450 passing, typecheck/lint/fmt clean. Commits 6a3182d0, 0a972fb1, d48ed661.
